name: normalized_payload
description: JSON-decoded log body used by the other normalized projections.

name: normalized_host
description: Stable short host name across OTLP resources, legacy events, and journald payloads.

name: normalized_source
description: Collector or application source for the event.

name: normalized_service
description: Service identity across structured events, OTLP resources, journald, and file logs.

name: normalized_message
description: Human-readable message across journald, legacy events, and raw file logs.

name: normalized_systemd_unit
description: Systemd unit extracted from a journald payload when present.

name: normalized_severity
description: Normalized severity from structured levels, application text markers, and journald priority.
expression: case(isnotempty(tostring(['attributes.level'])), tolower(tostring(['attributes.level'])), isnotempty(tostring(normalized_payload.level)), tolower(tostring(normalized_payload.level)), tostring(normalized_message) contains "<Fault>" or tostring(normalized_message) contains " FTL ", "fatal", tostring(normalized_message) contains "<Error>" or tostring(normalized_message) contains " ERR " or tostring(normalized_message) contains "EADDRINUSE", "error", tostring(normalized_message) contains "<Warning>" or tostring(normalized_message) contains " WRN ", "warn", tostring(normalized_message) contains "<Notice>" or tostring(normalized_message) contains "<Info>" or tostring(normalized_message) contains " INF ", "info", tostring(normalized_message) contains "<Debug>" or tostring(normalized_message) contains " DBG ", "debug", isnotempty(tostring(normalized_payload.PRIORITY)) and toint(normalized_payload.PRIORITY) <= 2, "fatal", isnotempty(tostring(normalized_payload.PRIORITY)) and toint(normalized_payload.PRIORITY) == 3, "error", isnotempty(tostring(normalized_payload.PRIORITY)) and toint(normalized_payload.PRIORITY) == 4, "warn", isnotempty(tostring(normalized_payload.PRIORITY)) and toint(normalized_payload.PRIORITY) <= 6, "info", isnotempty(tostring(normalized_payload.PRIORITY)) and toint(normalized_payload.PRIORITY) == 7, "debug", "unknown")

name: normalized_severity_number
description: OpenTelemetry severity band for normalized_severity: trace 1, debug 5, info 9, warn 13, error 17, fatal 21.
expression: case(normalized_severity == "fatal" or normalized_severity == "critical", 21, normalized_severity == "error", 17, normalized_severity == "warn" or normalized_severity == "warning", 13, normalized_severity == "info" or normalized_severity == "notice", 9, normalized_severity == "debug", 5, normalized_severity == "trace", 1, 0)
